Subject: Onboarding: PO / Invoice requirements & EU VAT agent flow

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're starting Redwood's vendor onboarding in our procurement system and I wanted to capture a few mandatory fields so our AP team can accept POs and process invoices without delays. Can you confirm the following for the Redwood legal entity that will issue invoices to KiteWorks (EU customers):

- Legal name to appear on invoices (exactly as in vendor portal)
- Registered VAT number (for reverse-charge vs VAT charged scenarios)
- Preferred remit-to bank details for SEPA / IBAN + BIC (file a stub is fine)
- Billing contact and email (for invoice queries and remittance advices)

Also, on our side we require either:
- a VAT registration number on the invoice (for standard VAT), or
- a signed self-billing / VAT agent mandate if KiteWorks is to apply reverse-charge on receipts.

Attached is our standard AP onboarding spec (KiteWorks_AP_Onboarding_Spec.xlsx) showing our portal fields and an example invoice. If you can return Redwood's vendor onboarding form and a sample invoice (PDF), we can provision you in our portal and issue the first PO.

We normally need vendor registration completed prior to issuing POs for new suppliers — can you advise an expected turnaround?

Best,
Elena

Hi Rachel / Marissa,

Thanks for the details — that helps. A couple of follow-ups from our AP team:

1) GL code mapping: our PO lines must include a 6-digit ledger code (GL) that we use for cost center allocation. Do you have a default GL mapping we should use on the PO or will you accept a blank GL and send an expense allocation with each invoice?

2) PO comments: we require the supplier legal name to match exactly and that the invoice "Invoice To" section contains "KiteWorks Inc. - EU Operations" so our matching rules trigger.

3) Self-billing: KiteWorks can operate a self-billing workflow but we need the signed mandate and confirmation of the entity that invoices (your Ireland entity) that accepts self-billing arrangement. We also need a sample PDF invoice showing the VAT position (reverse charge markup or VAT charged).

If you can upload the vendor form and the signed MSA plus bank stub to our portal (we will send an invite), we can move quickly. Target: provision by EOD Friday (2026-07-02).

Regards,
Marco
Marco Bianchi
Senior Procurement Operations
KiteWorks Inc.

- KiteWorks to send portal invite to supplier-portal@redwood-inference.com (we'll register and complete fields within 24–72 hours).
